title: ACLU Lawsuit Over Detained Migrants at Guantanamo Bay
text:
• Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth criticized the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) for its lawsuit regarding detained migrants at Guantanamo Bay.
• Hegseth claimed the ACLU has an agenda to 'make America look bad' and to undermine President Trump.
• The ACLU's lawsuit seeks access to detained migrants who have allegedly been flown to Guantanamo Bay without legal consultation or contact with relatives.
• The lawsuit's plaintiffs include relatives of three Venezuelan immigrants transferred from Texas immigration detention facilities to Guantanamo.
• The lawsuit accuses government officials of violating constitutional rights to due process and free speech.
• Plaintiffs' attorneys are requesting a court order to meet with the detainees and to require officials to disclose a detainee's location within 24 hours of transfer.
